english.title: Cause / permit a fire to occur in an unauthorised place at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a fire to occur in a place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), which was not constructed for that purpose at Southampton Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(3) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
caused / permitted a fire to occur
in a place which was not constructed for that purpose
at Southampton Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
